questions.prompt: What reaches one side of Earth?
choices: Sunlight reaches one side of Earth.
A river reaches one side of Earth.
A road reaches one side of Earth.
questions.answer: Sunlight reaches one side of Earth.
questions.evidenceText: Sunlight reaches one side of Earth.

questions.prompt: Which fact is explained next in Day and Night?
choices: Sunlight reaches one side of Earth.
Earth turns us toward sunlight again.

questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Day and Night?
choices: Earth's turning makes day and night.
Only sunlight reaches one side of Earth.
questions.answer: Earth's turning makes day and night.
questions.rationale: Sunlight reaches one side of Earth. That side has daytime. Earth turns us toward sunlight again. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Earth's turning makes day and night.
